gemini.rationale: The transaction was structured as a whole-company going-private merger where the entire corporate entity, products, operations, and workforce would transfer intact (1-1) to the new owner. There were no structural gaps designed into the deal, although the transaction was ultimately terminated before closing.

grok.rationale: The slice states the merger agreement was terminated before the effective time and that 'no merger consideration was ever paid or share conversion effected,' so no ownership-boundary crossing occurred at all. Because neither the customer-facing product/asset (T4) nor the operational processes (T5) nor the organization (T6) transferred, there is no product-vs-process mismatch (gap_45=0) and no process-vs-organization mismatch (gap_56=0) documentable at closing.

openai.rationale: The merger agreement was terminated before the effective time, and no merger consideration was paid or share conversion effected. Consequently, neither the customer-facing product nor its operational processes or organization crossed the ownership boundary, so no T4–T5 or T5–T6 structural mismatch arose at closing.
